label: B25-BOOT-WORD-PROVENANCE
title: Determine the authoritative reset-vector bytes across ELF, BIN, HEX and MIF
scope: Trace why lcvex_bram_init25_tb expects reset word 0x9100001f580017c0 while the current deterministic boot build produces 0x9100001f58001700. Establish the authoritative instruction/data bytes from source, linker layout, ELF disassembly, BIN, byte HEX and 64-bit MIF, including the commit that changed the literal offset. Do not modify source or expectations.
reads: git history affecting the boot assembly/link layout and test
docs/tasks/evidence/T-20260907-039.json and T-20260908-007 facts supplied in dispatch
validation: Rebuild the boot image without editing source and record tool/hash provenance.
Disassemble the first instructions and decode the LDR literal immediate/target for both old and current words.
Prove byte-for-byte agreement or disagreement among ELF load image, boot.bin, boot.hex and boot.mif first word and whole payload.
Identify whether the hardcoded constant is stale, the image is wrong, or the result is indeterminate.
acceptance: An evidence-backed verdict names one authoritative reset-vector value and exact cause/history; no tracked design/test file is modified.
resource: Boot build/disassembly only; acquire local only if the existing entry classifies it heavy. No GamePC/Quartus.
